title: 第19章 恶鬼想要夺舍她第20章 给我撞了没个十万二十万起不来
slug: 穿成女配弹幕让我又争又抢
content_zh:
鬼煞感知到一股无比强烈的正道气场，他本就只想吓唬云茵而已，并不想与那人交锋，直接溜之大吉。
黑暗的幻境土崩瓦解，云茵回过神来，她还好好的坐在床沿，她惊魂未定的喘着气，抬眼却瞧见屋中站着一个儒雅的男人。
男人穿着深蓝色锦袍，露出温和笑意，“云小姐，我路过客栈察觉到很重的阴邪之气，敲门许久你都未应，我怕你出事，这才自作主张闯了进来，希望你见谅。”
云茵听见声音有些耳熟，可一时半会儿又想不起来在哪里听过，只好作罢，她起身拱手一礼。
“公子说笑了，方才要不是公子出手相救，我的性命恐怕难保，我应该重谢公子才对。”
男人眼眸不经意往外一撇，道：“举手之劳，无需挂齿。”
他似有急事，说完就转身下楼快速离开。
云茵走到窗边，盯着那道渐行渐远的背影，脑海里闪过那日锦衣楼为她买单的公子身影，两者奇异的重合在一起。
她猛地一惊，意识到男人竟然知道她姓云。
“看来果然是位贵人。”云茵喃喃自语。
沈宴不知道何时才能再下山，她的心底当即有了新的盘算。
季月是被系统叮叮咚咚的提示音吵醒的。
【恭喜宿主，大女主人设触发，进度1%。】
【恭喜宿主，解锁商城，当前商城等级为1，可用已获取的礼物折算成人民币，购买10元含10元的任何物品。】
她的眼前出现半透的电子屏幕，系统深藏不露啊，现在才把好东西拿出来，她坐起身，试着点了下空中屏幕上的商城。
进入商城，顶框标注着数值1的等级，她手指往下滑懂，大于10块的物品是呈灰色且上着锁。
她又往回滑，一块到10块物品并不少，甚至左侧边框还贴心的有分类按钮，日用品、食物、百货、药品等一应俱全。
她大致游览了一遍，没什么想买的，在宗门有吃有喝，拥有独院，已经比某些天崩开局的穿越者幸福多了。
【骂我是给：我们昨晚错过了什么？主播咋觉醒的大女主人设？】
【建材美妇王阿姨：虽然才1%，但也值得庆祝，代表主播迈出了第一步。】

季月仔细回想着，昨晚就系统给出的三条选择很突兀，便一五一十地跟弹幕说了。
【性感母蟑螂：原来是这样，女频中大女主的人设，核心是拥有强大的实力，不会倚靠任何男人，掌握绝对的主动权。
系统给出三个选择，自始自终目的只有一个，让主播学会靠自己解决困难。】
季月并不觉得开心，她某些时刻和原主一样，喜欢咸鱼躺平的日子，可按弹幕所说的结论，以后她甚至要主动去陷入危险的情景，越多越好，还必须靠自己解决困境，来增加大女主人设的进度。
她犹豫的低头看胸口处金灿灿的荷花吊坠，忍痛把它取下来放进妆匣中。
【无能的丈夫：书中的物品再珍贵你也拿不走，你去给云茵找麻烦，争抢属于她的东西，大家会给你刷礼物的。】
季月唉声叹气一声，好吧，唯有冰冷的礼物来温暖她了。
【无能的丈夫：因为你成功让鬼煞叛变，云茵和她金主第一次正式见面提前了。
content_en:
Gui Sha sensed an extremely strong aura of righteousness. He just wanted to scare Yun Yin. He didn't want to confront that person and ran away.
The dark illusion collapsed, and Yun Yin came back to her senses. She was still sitting on the edge of the bed. She gasped in shock, but when she raised her eyes, she saw an elegant man standing in the room.
The man was wearing a dark blue brocade robe and showed a gentle smile, "Miss Yun, I passed by the inn and noticed a strong evil atmosphere. You didn't answer the door for a long time. I was afraid that something would happen to you, so I barged in on my own initiative. I hope you will forgive me."
Yun Yin heard that the voice sounded familiar, but for a while she couldn't remember where she had heard it before, so she had to give up. She stood up and bowed her hands.
"Young master is joking. If he hadn't come to the rescue just now, my life might not have been saved. I should thank you very much."
The man's eyes rolled out inadvertently and said: "It's a simple effort, no need to worry about it."
He seemed to be in a hurry, so after saying that, he turned around and went downstairs to leave quickly.
Yun Yin walked to the window and stared at the retreating figure. The figure of the young master who paid for her at Jinyilou flashed in her mind, and the two strangely overlapped together.
She was startled when she realized that the man actually knew her surname was Yun.
"It seems that he is indeed a noble man." Yun Yin murmured to herself.
Shen Yan didn't know when she could go down the mountain again, and she immediately had a new plan in her heart.
Ji Yue was woken up by the system's beeping sound.
[Congratulations to the host, the big mistress is set to trigger, and the progress is 1%. 】
[Congratulations to the host, you have unlocked the mall. The current mall level is 1. You can use the gifts you have received to convert them into RMB to purchase any item worth 10 yuan. 】
A semi-transparent electronic screen appeared in front of her eyes. The system was hidden. Only now did she take out the good things. She sat up and tried to click on the mall on the screen in the air.
Entering the mall, the top box was marked with a level of 1. She scrolled down to understand that items worth more than 10 yuan were gray and locked.
She slid back again, and there were quite a few items ranging from one to ten items. There were even thoughtful classification buttons on the left border, including daily necessities, food, department stores, medicines, etc.
She took a general tour and found nothing she wanted to buy. She had food and drink in the sect and a private courtyard. She was already much happier than some time-travelers at the beginning of Tianbeng.
[Scold me for: What did we miss last night? How did the anchor awaken as a heroine? 】
[Auntie Wang, the beautiful building materials woman: Although it is only 1%, it is still worthy of celebration. It represents the first step for the anchor. 】
Ji Yue thought about it carefully. The three choices given by the system last night were very unexpected, so she explained them to the barrage in detail.
[Sexy Female Cockroach: So that’s it. The core of the heroine’s character in the female video is to have strong strength, not to rely on any man, and to have absolute initiative.
The system gives three choices, and there is only one purpose from beginning to end, so that the anchor can learn to solve difficulties on his own. 】
Ji Yue doesn't feel happy. At certain times, like the original owner, she likes to lie flat. But according to the conclusion of the barrage, she will even have to take the initiative to get into dangerous situations in the future. The more, the better. She must also solve the difficulties on her own to increase the progress of the heroine's design.
She hesitantly looked down at the golden lotus pendant on her chest, reluctantly took it off and put it into her makeup box.
[Incompetent Husband: No matter how precious the items in the book are, you can’t take them away. If you go make trouble for Yun Yin and fight for what belongs to her, everyone will give you gifts. 】
Ji Yue sighed, okay, only cold gifts can warm her.
[Incompetent Husband: Because you successfully made Gui Sha rebel, the first official meeting between Yun Yin and her sponsor was brought forward.
